settings.order: reverse variant order each round; cold/warm/uncached share one fresh persistent profile
settings.cache: fresh persistent context per variant/route/round; warm normal reload; uncached HTTP cache disabled (process/code cache retained)
settings.transfer: Completed HTTP resources at the readiness snapshot; same-origin and all-origin totals reported separately. Missing external Worker completion uses ResourceTiming.transferSize (browser header estimate). In-flight/background transfers are not the complete navigation total.
